candidates.evidence: Andersen, Todorov & Ubukata (2021), Journal of Econometrics, DOI 10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.07.005: U.S. option-implied negative tail risk forecasts Japanese excess returns; Japan-specific predictors are generally weak.
candidates.guardrail: Do not substitute VIX or SKEW and call it the paper's tail-risk measure.

candidates.evidence: CFTC publishes free Nikkei yen-denominated Financial TFF/COT positioning, but the scout did not find strong direct peer-reviewed evidence that a frozen positioning transform predicts subsequent OSE/JNU returns.

2024 JJIE research finds unexpected BOJ large-scale ETF purchases had large positive instantaneous Nikkei effects; 2026 Nikkei futures work finds anticipated purchases mainly changed volume, not price.

next_directional_rule: Do not open a formal directional family until a substantively independent mechanism has both sufficiently direct evidence and executable rights-clean data.
